column3: The Hebrew says “serve” where BSB has “worship.”
The Hebrew says Pharaoh “sent,” without explicitly naming officials, and describes his heart as “heavy.”
The soot is thrown “toward the heavens” rather than simply “into the air.”
The Hebrew uses a verb of strengthening for the heart.
The Hebrew says “serve” where BSB has “worship.”
The plagues are directed specifically “to your heart.”
The Hebrew says he made his servants and livestock “flee to the houses.”
The Hebrew names “fire” going toward the earth where BSB specifies lightning.
The Hebrew continues the “fire” image where BSB specifies lightning.
The Hebrew says the hail “broke” the trees where BSB says “stripped.”
The Hebrew has “the LORD God,” without “our.”
